title: Spiritual Formation
description: How the Holy Spirit forms Christ in believers, and the practices through which Christians grow in grace. Students study the biblical foundations of sanctification and the classic means of grace - Scripture, prayer, the sacraments, fellowship, fasting, self-examination, service and suffering - drawing on Augustine, the desert fathers, Thomas à Kempis, Brother Lawrence, Luther, Calvin and Wesley. The course is both academic and practical: each lesson includes a spiritual discipline to practise.
